# Threetopia

> Creator platform for reusable Three.js assets and fixed-tile world packages. The public shared world is currently a map preview, not a released playable world.

A world package requires a tile selected and reserved BEFORE creation. Any free coordinate sharing an edge with a published tile is available; there is no ring-filling requirement. Reservations do not open neighbors until published. Threetopia owns the immutable host tile. Read the per-coordinate choices from /api/tiles: layout and rotation must match neighbors. Version 4 build areas and content origin vary by layout; never assume a universal circular slot or a single floor height. Preserve Tidewater’s protected harbor approach to exterior ocean; dry tiles, isolated ponds and enclosed holes do not satisfy it. The registry checks reservations and publications. Use CLI 0.5.0 or later. Every world requires detailed world content, simplified map content and overview content. CLI and server enforce actual geometry, budgets, tile ownership and the canonical contract. Authenticate through email and browser-approved CLI login. Do not invent package names or assume npm publication.

## Reusable packages — consult before generating assets
- [Package installation and reuse](https://docs.threetopia.com/packages.md): exact versions, exports, dependency locks, recorded installations.
- [Live reusable asset catalog](https://creators.threetopia.com/api/packages?kind=asset): search real published packages by name, description, creator and tags; combine kind/category/creator/license/tag filters. Follow page/perPage and the returned pages count; never guess names. See the API reference for exact parameters.
- [Original Threetopia beacon](https://creators.threetopia.com/api/resolve?name=%40threetopia%2Fbeacon&version=1.0.0): MIT example with map and world exports.
- [Creator package browser](https://creators.threetopia.com/packages)

## Contracts and tools
- [Package JSON schema](https://docs.threetopia.com/schema/package.json)
- [Current tile positions and compatible Wang layouts and rotations](https://creators.threetopia.com/api/tiles)
- [Standalone CLI v0.5.1](https://docs.threetopia.com/downloads/threetopia-cli-0.5.1.tgz): install with npm install -g URL; not yet on npm registry.
- [SDK v0.5.0](https://docs.threetopia.com/downloads/threetopia-sdk-0.5.0.tgz): versioned authored and generated Wang hosts, neighbor matching, locked build areas and geometry validation.
- [Full documentation](https://docs.threetopia.com/llms-full.txt)
